verdict: Organic presence is holding steady; paid channels remain dark this period.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — your businesses generated 429 combined Google Business Profile actions this period entirely through organic visibility, with no paid spend running on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement softened in the most recent 7 days at all three locations, and organic search clicks also declined at Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision, which points to a search visibility issue we are actively working to resolve. A web and SEO root-cause fix is in progress now, with full reindexing targeted by end of October. CRM account reconciliation work is also underway to clear the data blockers that have been holding back outreach automation, and contact pulling for lapsed-customer sequences is queued to launch in September.
